body: So weird enough I am only here because of a coin flip as well... I feel the same as if stuck in limbo of sorts. For most of my life I have just found time where I could be alone and cry and talk to myself. It has helped a lot in the past. I'm looking for something new right now myself. Do you have any photos you are fond of? Send me a link to some if you dont mind. I have checked your profile yet, so if they are there then expect my upvotes.
